plan.name: Show shell activity in the live view
plan.summary: This first slice of #211 classifies shell calls from both agents as reading, searching, listing, building, testing, version control or other, counting each call once and retaining its own start and end times when calls overlap. Recognize the literal command forms pinned by the acceptance tests, including quoting, shell wrappers, assignments and directory changes, keep mixed or unsupported commands as other, and list each explicit read/search file once per call only when it exists as a regular file and resolves inside the workspace; use inside to compare the canonical workspace and operand paths directly with filepath.Rel and filepath.IsLocal without stripping /private/, resolve real filesystem aliases at callers, and preserve logical cd through symlinks or classify ambiguous invocations as other with no files. Show each kind's count in the legend and its calls' start times and durations on the strip, with a distinct color for every shell kind in both themes, while keeping command text, patterns, output and outside paths out of public responses and never executing a transcript command. Update SPEC.md's live-view description with D-0116 and D-0136 citations and adjust the two existing transcript tests for shell reads; the merger must record the new decision refining D-0136 because this build cannot write decisions/. Leave the separate authenticated, default-off /act command-history toggle for the next slice, preserving incremental transcript polling and existing non-shell tools without changing the agent's run.

tests.name: TestShellCallsHaveKindsAndTimes
tests.says: Both agents' shell invocations have the right kind, one count and one timed mark, including common command wrappers; mixed and unsupported commands remain other.

tests.name: TestShellReadsAndSearchesPublishOnlyWorkspaceFiles
tests.says: Both agents' explicit read/search file operands appear as deduplicated workspace-relative reads, while patterns, output, directories, missing files, escaping paths and commands never reach the public JSON or execute.

tests.name: TestShellActivityUsesOnlyNewWholeTranscriptEvents
tests.says: Polling counts only complete new events, preserves the kind while a command is running, closes its mark on completion and never recounts old commands or rediscovers their paths.

tests.name: TestOverlappingShellCallsKeepTheirOwnTimes
tests.says: Overlapping shell calls end at their own results, including out-of-order and batched results, while unrelated messages cannot stop a call and older results without IDs still work.

tests.name: TestShellKindsHaveDistinctStripColors
tests.says: The served stylesheet gives all seven shell kinds distinct colors in both themes, matching each kind's strip mark, duration band and legend swatch.

tests.name: TestShellFilesUseCanonicalContainment
tests.says: Canonical containment keeps /private/work and /work distinct, while both agents publish files through a real workspace alias and reject operands reached through an escaping directory symlink.

tests.name: TestShellCDThroughSymlinksUsesLogicalPathsOrOther
tests.says: For both agents, cd through link -> real/sub followed by .. reports the logical workspace file, or counts the invocation as other with no files; ordinary cd reads still work.
